description: Search NESO (National Energy System Operator, ex National Grid ESO) open data for UK electricity grid datasets — GB power demand forecasts, wind generation forecasts, carbon intensity, balancing costs, historic demand, energy system data. Returns dataset slug/id, title, summary, and resource count. Example: neso_search_datasets({ query: "wind forecast" })

query.description: Keyword(s), e.g. "demand forecast", "wind", "carbon intensity". Blank lists all datasets.

name: neso_search_datasets
title: Neso Search Datasets
